decisions.reason: The organic vegan superfood drink mix has almost nothing in common with the firm's knowledge of waste-to-energy engineering, so the firm can hardly read its early results or improve it, and its resources are better spent on the core plant technology.

The modular plant extensions build directly on the firm's WASTX plant know-how and add to its core systems, though their low web presence and the missing website archives for 2020 and 2021 leave some doubt.

WASTX Oil is the flagship product with its own page and a formal launch announcement, and it sits at the centre of the firm's accumulated engineering and R&D knowledge, so the firm is best placed to learn from it and improve it.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant shares technology and market knowledge with the waste-oil plant and was promoted to its own page in 2019, so it fits the firm's absorptive capacity, though as a start-up product it carries commercial risk.
